messages.content: tumi ki mone koro apology sotti kichu fix kore, naki eta just formality?
Depends entirely on whether it's followed by changed behavior. Empty words apart from action, eta just formality thake. Tumi kono specific apology niye bhabcho?
hae, ekjon amake sorry bole but same mistake repeat kore
That's the clearest sign an apology isn't landing as real accountability, just words to smooth things over temporarily. Kotobar eta hoyeche already?

Three times with the same pattern moves this out of the "honest mistake" category and into something more concerning. At this point, the apology itself has basically become part of the cycle rather than a genuine correction.
